name: Miss Fortune
title: the Bounty Hunter

Q.name: Double Up
Q.description: Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing 20/45/70/95/120 + 1×AD + 0.35×AP physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them. The second shot can critically strike for (20/45/70/95/120 + 1×AD + 0.35×AP) × (1 + (0.5 × (1×stat + -1))) physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.
Q.summary: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

W.name: Strut
W.description: Passive: After 4 seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains 30/35/40/45/50 Move Speed. After another 3 seconds, this increases to 60/70/80/90/100. Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and 40/55.0/70/85/100% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by (2) × ? seconds.
W.summary: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

E.name: Make It Rain
E.description: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, Slowing by 0.4 + 0.001×AP and dealing 45/60/75/90/105 + 0.6×AP magic damage per second for 2 seconds (total (45/60/75/90/105 + 0.6×AP) × 2 magic damage).
E.summary: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

R.name: Bullet Time
R.description: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing 14/16/18 waves over 3 seconds, dealing 20/30/40 + 0.6×AD + 0.25×AP physical damage per wave (total (20/30/40 + 0.6×AD + 0.25×AP) × 14/16/18 physical damage). Each wave can critically strike for %i:scaleCrit% (20/30/40 + 0.6×AD + 0.25×AP) × (1 + (0.45 × (1×stat + -1))) physical damage.
R.summary: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

Passive.name: Love Tap
Passive.description: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.
Passive.summary: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Lane-bully marksman who pokes with the bouncing Q and wins teamfights with the R channel. Wins lane through strong early damage and the E slow zone.
strengths: Q bounce poke can crit the second target, punishing enemies who stand behind minions
E zone slows and reveals, good with engage supports
R channel deals huge area damage in teamfights
Passive bonus damage when switching targets
W move speed for kiting and roaming
weaknesses: No dash: very vulnerable to dives and hard engage
R is a channel that crowd control interrupts
Falls off against high-mobility, skillshot-dodging bot lanes
Relies on engage support to land R

curve.items: strong – lethality or crit (Collector, Yun Tal)

profile.curveNote: Q poke and W chase early; strongest with a lockdown support.

Passive.notes: Bonus damage on attacks against a new target.

Q.notes: Shot bounces to a target behind; second hit can crit.

W.notes: Move speed and attack speed; passive speed lost on damage.

E.notes: Area slow and vision for 2 s.

R.notes: 3 s channel cone; interrupted by crowd control.

profile.windowAgainst: W/E down, or after R is cast: dive her. She has no escape.
checks: Whether Jax E dodges Q (it applies on-hit effects) and whether projectile blocks stop each R wave.
